question: Should ClawHub adopt durable private publisher follows and permanent in-app publication notifications as a first-class product and authenticated API contract?
rationale: The branch creates permanent private relationship/history data and publish-time fanout; source correctness and tests cannot decide whether maintainers want that lasting product, privacy, retention, and operational boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the full notification stack
options.body: Accept the product boundary, then require the scan-gating fix, resolved stack, real Convex proof, and focused security review before merge.

options.title: Land follows without notifications
options.body: Accept the follow graph and discovery controls while deferring permanent notification rows and publish-time fanout.

options.title: Decline the social feature
options.body: Close the stacked drafts if durable follows and publication notifications are outside ClawHub’s intended product scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full notification stack
recommendation.body: Accept the product boundary, then require the scan-gating fix, resolved stack, real Convex proof, and focused security review before merge.
